sloka: गदाप्रहारं तं घोरमचिन्त्य प्लवगोत्तमः ।तां शिलां पातयामास तस्योरसि महामृधे ।। ६.४३.४० ।।।।
transliteration: gadāprahāraṁ taṁ ghoramacintya plavagottamaḥ ।tāṁ śilāṁ pātayāmāsa tasyorasi mahāmṛdhe ।। 6.43.40 ।।।।

translations.english: Vidyunmali, the Rakshasa hit by the huge rock, was ceased of life.
